dashboard.title: Who needs attention
dashboard.description: A few people who might appreciate a word this week.
dashboard.allClearBody: Nothing is waiting on you. Thank you.

mentees.title: Mentees
mentees.emptyBody: When your organisation's admin assigns you someone, they appear here.

mentee.visibilityNote: You can see what {name} chooses to share, plus their milestones, goals and progress. Private writing stays private.
mentee.affirmHelp: Mark a moment you noticed in {name}'s growth.
mentee.notesPrivate: Only you can read these. {name} never sees them.
mentee.notePlaceholder: What did you notice? What will you follow up on?

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Reflections people have shared with you, longest-waiting first.
feedback.emptyWaitingBody: When someone shares a reflection with you, it will appear here.

snippet.thanks: Thank you, {name}, for writing so honestly.
snippet.notice: Something that stood out to me was
snippet.question: A question to take with you this week:
snippet.pray: I'll be praying for you this week.

feedback.shareable: Allow this reply to be shown to their group
feedback.shareableHelp: Only for reflections they've shared with the group.
feedback.affirmHelp: If this reflection shows growth, you can mark it for {name}.
feedback.aiLater: An AI drafting assistant will be added here later. Replies are always written and sent by you.

builder.libraryDescription: Build and share guided journeys of lessons.
builder.newHelp: Start from scratch or copy an existing pathway.
builder.noneTitle: You haven't built a pathway yet
builder.noneBody: Start from a template or from scratch.
builder.fromHelp: Copying keeps every module and lesson as a draft.
builder.publishBody: People you assign it to, and anyone in your organisation, will be able to start it.
builder.publishedBody: You can now assign it to your mentees.
builder.assignBody: They'll be notified and it will appear on their Today page.
builder.assigned: {count, plural, =0 {Everyone was already on it} one {Assigned to # person} other {Assigned to # people}}
builder.reorderHelp: Reorder with the grip handle (keyboard: focus it, press Space, then the arrow keys), or use the up and down buttons.
builder.noLessons: No lessons in this module yet.
builder.deleteBody: Its modules and lessons will be removed. Pathways that people are on can't be deleted.

editor.title: Edit lesson
editor.notAuthor: Only the author of this pathway can edit its lessons.
editor.conflict: This lesson was changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest version.
editor.requireReflectionHelp: Encourages a reflection, but never blocks finishing.
editor.noBlocks: This lesson is empty. Add a block to begin.
editor.referenceInvalid: That reference isn't in the Bible. Try a form like John 3:16.
editor.caption: Caption (optional)
editor.guidanceHelp: A short hint under the prompt.
editor.audioHelp: This text is read aloud by the student's device.
editor.videoHelp: Choose one of the demo videos. Captions are included.
editor.question: Question {n}
editor.optionsHelp: Tick the correct answer or answers.
editor.explanationHelp: Shown after they answer. Keep it kind.
